therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Surgical mitral valvuloplasty with placement of annular ring (SMVR)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of mitral regurgitation and left ventricular reverse remodeling
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with significant mitral regurgitation and non-ischemic congestive heart failure
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: LV End-systolic Volume Index (LVESVI) at Month 18

safety_signals: Trial terminated due to inability to recruit sufficient numbers of patients; only 2 patients enrolled
No patients reached the 18-month primary/secondary endpoint measurement window
1 patient in Medical Therapy Only arm experienced cardiac failure (SAE)
1 patient in Medical Therapy Only arm experienced haemodynamic instability (SAE)
1 patient in Medical Therapy Plus Surgery arm experienced atrial fibrillation (SAE)
Perioperative mortality (Day 0-30): 0 in surgery arm, 0 in medical therapy arm

context.indication: Mitral valve insufficiency with non-ischemic congestive heart failure
context.investigator_commentary: Unable to recruit sufficient numbers of patients. The 2 patients enrolled did not meet the 18-month measurement of primary/secondary endpoints before the trial was terminated. No analysis was performed for most endpoints.
